plumbing.name: Residential Code of Ohio Chapters 25-33 (OAC 4101:8-25-01 et seq., 2018 IRC base); Ohio Plumbing Code (2021 IPC base) for other buildings

elsewhere: RCO applies statewide to one-, two- and three-family dwellings; enforced where the local government has a certified residential building department, otherwise by the county or state. Frost depth is set locally.

stairs.maxRiser.amendment: Ohio RCO allows riser up to 8 1/4 in

stairs.minTread.amendment: Ohio RCO tread at least 9 in

notes: Ohio's residential code is still 2018-based, so IRC 2021 changes (and 2021 IECC) do not apply. Ohio amends the 2018 IECC with its own less stringent provisions; edition-based derivation will overstate energy requirements. RCO 314.1.2 has a dual-technology smoke alarm interpretation.
